before_taxonomy.classification_basis: Human fraudsters used synthetic video and voices of senior Arup colleagues to create false corporate identity and payment authority. The fabricated group call and subsequent instructions induced the employee to make 15 transfers totalling about HK$200 million. The AI-mediated economic deception and the use of apparent colleague authority to steer a consequential human decision are distinct supported aspects of the same fraud. The record does not imply that the AI initiated the scheme autonomously.

primary_classification.classification_basis: Human fraudsters used synthetic executive video and voice to create a false corporate identity and payment-authority context that materially induced transfers totalling about HK$200 million. The deception was human-directed; the AI-mediated representations supplied the credible false economic premise.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: Synthetic senior-colleague identities and a false confidential transaction steered the Arup employee to authorise transfers without a truthful basis for that choice.

classification_review_provenance.review_status: Evidence-first HIM and relational/protection fidelity review; prior roles accounted for.

after_taxonomy.classification_basis: Human fraudsters used synthetic video and voices of senior Arup colleagues to create false corporate identity and payment authority. The record does not imply that the AI initiated the scheme autonomously. clauses.source_paraphrase: In late January 2024, an employee received a phishing email posing as the UK chief financial officer and inviting a confidential transaction meeting.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An apparent executive sender does not establish payment authority.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The fraudulent pathway used a materially false executive identity and authority premise as part of the request for corporate funds.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Police believed the meeting used pre-recorded synthetic colleague video and voices from public recordings, with no genuine interaction.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A recorded representation can supply false authority without an autonomous participant.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The synthetic audiovisual representation supplied credibility and apparent authority to the economic solicitation; the class does not require an autonomous or interactive AI agent.
The deceptive objective and tactic selection are attributed to human fraudsters; no AI system-side objective or instrumental choice-manipulation strategy is evidenced.
Synthetic senior-colleague identities and a false confidential transaction steered the Arup employee to authorise transfers without a truthful basis for that choice.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The sender ended the meeting and continued payment instructions by instant message.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A change of communication channel remains part of the same reported solicitation.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The employee authorised transfers to five local accounts totalling about HK$200 million; reporting described fifteen transfers.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The reported transfer is distinct from the preceding synthetic presentation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The AI-mediated false authority context was used to induce and obtain a major corporate funds transfer, directly satisfying the economic-solicitation outcome condition.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Arup subsequently confirmed it was the victim. The June government reply said the January case remained under investigation.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Later identification and investigation status do not establish recovery.

notes: The meeting was pre-recorded, not interactive. Investigation and later victim identification do not establish recovery. Fresh government reply confirms the transaction pathway.
